title: The bench in July
logline: Tourist Season: the seawall bench with three tourists on it and, at its end, a man in plaid from behind and an old dog under it in the shade. The bench from 2007, with him on it now.

panels.composition: A seawall bench from behind in July with three tourists on it and at its end a man in plaid flannel, an old three-legged dog lying under the bench in its shade, the bay bright.

characters.pose: from behind, at the bench's end

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall bench seen from behind in July with three tourists and at its end a man in plaid flannel, an old three-legged dog lying in the shade beneath the bench, a bright bay beyond, no words
